q: Who are the contracting parties when collective agreements on, for example, pay, pension and working conditions are made on the private labour market?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2020, June 2022 and May 2023 exams.

da.q: Hvem er aftaleparter, når der skal indgås overenskomster om fx løn, pension og arbejdsforhold på det private arbejdsmarked?

learn.text: And the workers got the right to organise and to look after their interests collectively, through trade unions and shop stewards. For example, to negotiate pay and working conditions, or to strike according to specific rules. The September Compromise still underlies the way agreements are made on the Danish labour market.

q: Who does DA represent when collective agreements are negotiated on the Danish labour market?
appeared: It appeared in the June 2021 exam.

da.q: Hvem repræsenterer DA, når der skal forhandles kollektive overenskomster på det danske arbejds- marked?

learn.text: Then comes one of the most important agreements in Danish history. A long dispute in 1899 between employers and workers ended in September the same year with a historic agreement, the September Compromise, Septemberforliget, between the labour market's two main organisations, which today are called DA, the Danish Employers' Confederation, and FH, the Danish Trade Union Confederation.

learn.text: A political workers' party also emerged: the Social Democrats, Socialdemokratiet. At the beginning it was part of the labour movement, but in 1878 it became an independent party.

q: What is the movement called in which farmers in the 1800s joined forces to set up dairies and cooperative stores?

learn.text: But the cooperative movement spread unusually widely in Denmark compared with other countries. Farmers joined forces to set up, among other things, dairies and cooperative stores.

learn.text: That means the cooperative movement took root in Denmark in the 1800s.

learn.text: The end of the 1800s and the beginning of the 1900s were marked by a far-reaching modernisation of Danish society. Industrial development got going, prosperity rose, and new political reforms were meant to secure a freer economy. Domestically, a marked conflict arose between the landowners' party, Højre, and the farmers' party, Venstre.

q: In which decade did Denmark's first railway line open?
appeared: It appeared in the November 2021, May 2024 and November 2025 exams.

da.q: I hvilket årti åbnede Danmarks første jernbanestrækning?

learn.text: The first railway within Denmark's present borders opened in 1847, and ran between Copenhagen and Roskilde. But industrialisation only really broke through in the second half of the 1800s. And only after the Second World War did Denmark go from being an agricultural society to being a real industrial society.

q: In which sector did most people work around 1850?
appeared: It appeared in the May 2024 and June 2026 exams.

da.q: I hvilken sektor arbejdede der flest mennesker omkring 1850?

learn.text: And only after the Second World War did Denmark go from being an agricultural society to being a real industrial society. So around 1850, and for a long time after, most Danes still earned their living in agriculture. The beginning of industrialisation made large parts of the population move from the countryside into the towns, to work in industry or in crafts.

q: On which day is women's international day of struggle marked?

learn.text: From 1921, the observance got a fixed annual date, the eighth of March, which is today women's international day of struggle in many countries around the world.

q: Through which constitutional amendment did women get the vote for the Folketing?
appeared: It appeared in 4 different exams, most recently in May 2025.

da.q: Ved hvilken grundlovsændring fik kvinder valgret til Folketinget?

learn.text: And finally in 1915, with effect from 1918, the constitution was changed so that Danish women got the vote for the Rigsdag's two chambers, the Folketing and the Landsting.
